errors.text: The proposed B2 or Heusler secondary phase replaces the target C14 Laves phase without evidence that such a phase can be formed in the specified Fe-Co-Ni-Ti composition while retaining a continuous fcc matrix.

The claimed increase in orbital-moment alignment and magnetic coercivity is not supported by the cited evidence; most citations concern mechanical dislocation pinning, phase constitution, or stacking-fault energy rather than magnetic domain-wall pinning or orbital moments.
The hypothesis misses the key sublattice coupling mechanism involving Fe/Co/Ni and Ti and does not predict the distinct C14- and fcc-derived magnetic transitions.
